name: Collide Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Collide Capital (collidecap.com), the early-stage VC firm founded by Aaron Samuels and Brian Hollins that invests pre-seed to Series A in fintech, supply chain and future of work; its press page links the April 2026 TechCrunch and ImpactAlpha coverage of its $95M Fund II. Not Collider Ventures (Israel), a separate firm.

pages.title: Collide Capital raises $95M fund to back fintech, future-of-work startups
Collide Capital raises $95 million for 'most deserving' fintech, supply chain and future of work founders
